lines.label: Tax K3 (GST on air transport)
lines.basis: DGCA-CAR-S3-M-II — Statutory taxes and airport charges are refundable on cancellation, non-utilisation or no-show, INCLUDING on promotional and special fares where the basic fare is non-refundable. Obligation attaches to the operating permit (Rule 133A of the Aircraft Rules, 1937), not to fare filing, so it binds this carrier regardless of PSS.

rules_rejected.detail: Rule quarantined: Structurally unverified: The source prints a fare-family x time-band grid — columns 'Lite Fare | Regular Fare | Flexi Plus Fare | Return Fare', each with its own band label — but this rule encodes the figures as three time bands for all fare families. The flattened capture text cannot settle the column-to-band mapping, and the corpus's own caveat records the mapping as inferred. A number derived from a misread grid is wrong even at LOW confidence, so the rule is withheld from resolution until it is re-transcribed from the rendered page.
